{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted once, with their latest (superseding) sample
deduplicated_df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now count unique patients
num_unique_patients = len(deduplicated_df)

print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {num_unique_patients}')"}
